activation_baseline.basis: Caelen Morrow v676-v8 immutable repository seal and acknowledged activation truth, kept separate from Eiren startup failures.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A PowerShell foreach projection was piped without materialization and raised EmptyPipeElement.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The rows were materialized before conversion and only the missing read-only projection was rerun.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The complete activation packet exceeded one visible display envelope.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Bounded numbered windows completed the exact committed packet through EOF without changing it.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A combined small-document read truncated before every source document reached EOF.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The incomplete files were read separately through EOF and no source was mutated.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The complete final-owner manifest listing exceeded the available context window.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Bounded manifest windows and structured count projections completed the exact same file.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A source-manifest projection guessed the digest key sha256 although the schema uses sha256_normalized_lf.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The real manifest keys were inspected before the corrected read-only projection.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A large mandatory-skill display overflowed before every selected SKILL.md reached EOF.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Each selected skill and required reference was read in bounded numbered windows through EOF.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: Two rg probes passed Windows wildcard path operands that rg rejected.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The probes were repeated only with explicit paths and include globs.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first combined current-state beacon displays truncated the historical payloads.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Full JSON parsing, exact hashes, and bounded field projections classified all three beacons as historical v557 evidence rather than live route authority.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first worktree preflight placed command separators inside a parenthesized projection and raised a missing-closing-parenthesis parser error.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Separate scalar commands recovered exact source, branch, path, and remote truth without mutation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The corrected worktree preflight exceeded its first presentation window while the read-only process continued.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The original session was awaited to completion and no duplicate preflight was launched.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A normalized-LF baton probe joined git-show lines without restoring the final newline and produced an incorrect byte count and digest presentation.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The exact Git blob and Caelen canonical receipt established the authoritative byte count and SHA-256 without replaying validation.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: Worktree creation reported an inherited non-cone sparse-pattern warning while materialization continued.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The original session completed once and the intended sparse list, exact source head, Eiren branch, and clean lane were verified.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A manifest read guessed a nested final-validation directory that does not exist in the Caelen packet.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The bounded phase tree revealed the exact validation/final-owner-manifest.json path before further schema reads.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first x1 constants patch used one stale inherited context sentence and failed without changing the file.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The exact current context was reread and the narrowly corrected patch applied once.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first source-bounded Eiren title slate failed closed with ten inherited semantic collisions or quarantined neighbors.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Only those ten titles were rewritten; the isolated audit then found zero exact collisions, zero quarantined rows, zero parse failures, and maximum Jaccard 0.666667 below 0.75.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: A combined substantive x1 patch contained an inherited overview sentence that no longer matched and applied no changes.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The exact current fields and overview were reread, then patched in two bounded reviewable changes.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: One rg inspection pattern lost its quoted successor token and failed with an unclosed-group regex error.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Independent literal expressions replaced the compound regex and recovered only the requested locations.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first mechanical template copy placed untracked future x2 and final Eiren surfaces in the planning-only worktree before x1 freeze.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Those owner-new files were never staged or executed and were removed after exact parent-scope checks; only the core, x1 builder, x1 manifest, and x1 test remained for the freeze.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first exact path-bounded PowerShell cleanup was rejected by host command policy before deleting any file.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: Patch-based deletion removed only the seventeen newly copied untracked Eiren future-lifecycle files.

startup_failure_recovery_pairs.failure: The first semantic-audit summary projection guessed four non-existent count field names and returned null presentations.
startup_failure_recovery_pairs.recovery: The exact audit schema keys were inspected and the source-bounded counts were recovered without rerunning the audit.
